Gulpin

Poison

Hoenn · Generation 3

Gulpin is a Poison-type Stomach Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 10.3 kg. It evolves into Swalot. Its highest base stat is HP (70), with a base stat total of 302.
